title: Pools are incompatible with non-standard ERC20 tokens
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium, as it limits the possible pools in the app and with some special ones can result in loss of funds  **Likelihood:** Medium, as some of the tokens are not uncommon, like `USDT`  ## Description  The Solidly V3 AMM code removes the balance checks before and after transfers and also the `TransferHelper` library, calling the `transfer` and `transferFrom` methods of ERC20 directly.
